AI.title_translation: 软件工程研究中开放科学的现状：以ICSE成果物为例的案例研究
AI.tldr: 对过去十年ICSE的100个复制包进行评估发现，只有40%可执行，其中仅35%可重现原始结果。开放科学实践在软件工程中存在显著的可用性、可执行性和可重现性差距。
AI.motivation: 尽管软件工程（SE）研究中的成果物共享（复制包）已成为标准做法，但其可用性仍未得到充分探索。特别是，缺乏对SE研究中复制包的可执行性和可重现性进行全面检查的研究。
AI.method: 评估了过去十年（2015-2024年）ICSE会议上发布的100个复制包。评估内容包括：（1）可执行性，（2）执行所需的努力和修改，（3）阻碍可执行性的挑战，以及（4）原始发现的可重现性。总共花费了约650人时。
AI.result: 只有40%的成果物可执行，其中32.5%（13/40）无需修改即可运行。82.5%（33/40）需要中等到高程度的努力才能成功执行。确定了五种常见的修改类型和13种导致执行失败的挑战（涉及环境、文档和结构问题）。在可执行的成果物中，只有35%（14/40）重现了原始结果。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了成果物可用性、可执行性和可重现性之间存在显著差距。本研究提出了三项可操作的指南，以改进研究成果物的准备、文档和评审，从而加强SE研究中开放科学实践的严谨性和可持续性。
AI.translation: 复制包对于实现软件工程（SE）研究中的透明度、验证和重用至关重要。虽然成果物共享现在是标准做法，甚至在像ICSE这样的顶级SE会议中是预期要求，但这些复制包的实际可用性仍未得到充分探索。特别是，缺乏全面检查SE研究中复制包可执行性和可重现性的研究。在本文中，我们旨在通过评估过去十年（2015年至2024年）作为ICSE会议记录一部分发布的100个复制包来填补这一空白。我们评估了（1）复制包的可执行性，（2）执行它们所需的努力和修改，（3）阻碍可执行性的挑战，以及（4）原始发现的可重现性。我们总共花费了大约650人时来执行这些成果物并重现研究发现。我们的发现揭示，在评估的100个成果物中，只有40%是可执行的，其中32.5%（40个中的13个）无需任何修改即可运行。关于努力程度，17.5%（40个中的7个）需要低努力，而82.5%（40个中的33个）需要中等到高努力才能成功执行。我们确定了五种常见的修改类型和13种导致执行失败的挑战，涉及环境、文档和结构问题。在可执行的成果物中，只有35%（40个中的14个）重现了原始结果。这些发现强调了成果物可用性、可执行性和可重现性之间存在显著差距。我们的研究提出了三项可操作的指南，以改进研究成果物的准备、文档和评审，从而加强SE研究中开放科学实践的严谨性和可持续性。
AI.summary: 本文旨在评估软件工程领域顶级会议ICSE中研究成果物（复制包）的实际可用性、可执行性和可重现性。通过对过去十年（2015-2024）的100个复制包进行大规模评估，研究发现仅有40%的成果物可执行，且在可执行的成果物中，只有35%能够重现原始研究结果。研究量化了执行所需的努力，并识别了导致失败的13种挑战。这些发现揭示了开放科学实践在软件工程研究中存在的巨大差距，并提出了改进成果物准备、文档和评审的实用指南。
AI.keywords: 开放科学, 软件工程研究, 复制包, 可执行性, 可重现性
AI.comments: 这项研究非常重要，因为它提供了关于软件工程（SE）领域开放科学实践现状的定量和令人担忧的证据。尽管顶级会议如ICSE强调成果物共享，但其结果表明，大多数共享的复制包在实践中缺乏可执行性和可重现性。创新点在于其评估的规模（100个成果物，650人时）和对失败原因的详细分类（13种挑战）。这项工作为SE社区敲响了警钟，并为提高研究严谨性和可持续性提供了具体的、基于证据的改进方向。

title: Multi-scale Graph Autoregressive Modeling: Molecular Property Prediction via Next Token Prediction
summary: We present Connection-Aware Motif Sequencing (CamS), a graph-to-sequence representation that enables decoder-only Transformers to learn molecular graphs via standard next-token prediction (NTP). For molecular property prediction, SMILES-based NTP scales well but lacks explicit topology, whereas graph-native masked modeling captures connectivity but risks disrupting the pivotal chemical details (e.g., activity cliffs). CamS bridges this gap by serializing molecular graphs into structure-rich causal sequences. CamS first mines data-driven connection-aware motifs. It then serializes motifs via scaffold-rooted breadth-first search (BFS) to establish a stable core-to-periphery order. Crucially, CamS enables hierarchical modeling by concatenating sequences from fine to coarse motif scales, allowing the model to condition global scaffolds on dense, uncorrupted local structural evidence. We instantiate CamS-LLaMA by pre-training a vanilla LLaMA backbone on CamS sequences. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on MoleculeNet and the activity-cliff benchmark MoleculeACE, outperforming both SMILES-based language models and strong graph baselines. Interpretability analysis confirms that our multi-scale causal serialization effectively drives attention toward cliff-determining differences.

AI.title_translation: 多尺度图自回归建模：通过下一词元预测进行分子性质预测
AI.tldr: 引入CamS（连接感知基序序列化）方法，将分子图转化为结构丰富的序列。这使得标准解码器-only Transformer（如CamS-LLaMA）能通过下一词元预测进行分子性质预测，并在分子性质预测基准测试中达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于SMILES的下一词元预测（NTP）缺乏明确拓扑结构，而图原生掩码建模可能破坏关键化学细节（如活性悬崖）。本文的动机是弥合这一差距，通过将分子图序列化为结构丰富的因果序列。
AI.method: 提出连接感知基序序列化（CamS）。该方法首先挖掘数据驱动的连接感知基序，然后通过以支架为根的广度优先搜索（BFS）将基序序列化，建立稳定的核心到外围的顺序。关键在于，它通过连接从细到粗尺度的基序序列，实现分层建模。最后，使用CamS序列预训练一个标准的LLaMA骨干网络（CamS-LLaMA）。
AI.result: CamS-LLaMA在MoleculeNet和活性悬崖基准测试MoleculeACE上取得了最先进的性能（SOTA），优于基于SMILES的语言模型和强大的图基线。可解释性分析证实其多尺度因果序列化能有效引导注意力关注决定悬崖的关键差异。
AI.conclusion: CamS成功地将分子图转化为结构丰富的因果序列，使得基于LLaMA的Transformer模型能够通过下一词元预测有效地进行分子性质预测，并在多个基准测试中实现了SOTA性能和增强的可解释性。
AI.translation: 我们提出了连接感知基序序列化（CamS），这是一种图到序列的表示方法，它使仅有解码器的Transformer模型能够通过标准的下一词元预测（NTP）来学习分子图。对于分子性质预测，基于SMILES的NTP具有良好的可扩展性，但缺乏明确的拓扑结构；而图原生掩码建模虽然捕获了连通性，但可能破坏关键的化学细节（例如活性悬崖）。CamS通过将分子图序列化为结构丰富的因果序列来弥合这一差距。CamS首先挖掘数据驱动的连接感知基序。然后，它通过以支架为根的广度优先搜索（BFS）来序列化基序，以建立稳定的核心到外围的顺序。至关重要的是，CamS通过连接从细到粗基序尺度的序列来实现分层建模，允许模型根据密集、未被破坏的局部结构证据来调节全局支架。我们通过在CamS序列上预训练一个标准的LLaMA骨干网络来实例化CamS-LLaMA。它在MoleculeNet和活性悬崖基准测试MoleculeACE上取得了最先进的性能，优于基于SMILES的语言模型和强大的图基线。可解释性分析证实，我们的多尺度因果序列化有效地将注意力导向决定悬崖的关键差异。
AI.summary: CamS是一种将分子图转化为结构化序列的新方法，利用数据驱动的连接感知基序和基于BFS的序列化，创建了从细到粗的多尺度序列。这种表示允许标准的解码器-only LLaMA模型（CamS-LLaMA）使用下一词元预测进行分子性质预测。CamS-LLaMA成功弥补了SMILES表示缺乏拓扑结构和图掩码模型破坏关键信息的缺陷，在MoleculeNet和MoleculeACE基准测试中实现了SOTA性能。
AI.keywords: 分子性质预测, 图自回归建模, 下一词元预测, 多尺度, CamS
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于成功地将语言建模的可扩展性与图表示的结构完整性相结合。通过设计CamS序列化（连接感知和多尺度，从细到粗），作者解决了在不使用可能破坏信息的掩码技术的情况下，保留分子拓扑的关键问题。采用标准的LLaMA骨干网络是一个重要的实际优势，表明先进的LLM架构可以通过巧妙的数据表示应用于复杂的化学任务。在“活性悬崖基准”上的优异表现，突出了该方法在处理微小结构变化导致剧烈性质变化问题上的实用性。

title: Optimal Oblivious Load-Balancing for Sparse Traffic in Large-Scale Satellite Networks
summary: Oblivious load-balancing in networks involves routing traffic from sources to destinations using predetermined routes independent of the traffic, so that the maximum load on any link in the network is minimized. We investigate oblivious load-balancing schemes for a $N\times N$ torus network under sparse traffic where there are at most $k$ active source-destination pairs. We are motivated by the problem of load-balancing in large-scale LEO satellite networks, which can be modelled as a torus, where the traffic is known to be sparse and localized to certain hotspot areas. We formulate the problem as a linear program and show that no oblivious routing scheme can achieve a worst-case load lower than approximately $\frac{\sqrt{2k}}{4}$ when $1<k \leq N^2/2$ and $\frac{N}{4}$ when $N^2/2\leq k\leq N^2$. Moreover, we demonstrate that the celebrated Valiant Load Balancing scheme is suboptimal under sparse traffic and construct an optimal oblivious load-balancing scheme that achieves the lower bound. Further, we discover a $\sqrt{2}$ multiplicative gap between the worst-case load of a non-oblivious routing and the worst-case load of any oblivious routing. The results can also be extended to general $N\times M$ tori with unequal link capacities along the vertical and horizontal directions.

AI.title_translation: 稀疏流量下大规模卫星网络的最佳无感知负载均衡
AI.tldr: 研究了稀疏流量下环面网络（模拟LEO卫星网络）的无感知负载均衡。证明了著名的Valiant方案不是最优的，并通过线性规划建立了一个理论下界，并构造了一个达到该下界的最佳无感知负载均衡方案。
AI.motivation: 解决大规模低轨（LEO）卫星网络中的负载均衡问题。这类网络可以建模为环面网络（torus network），其特点是流量稀疏且局限于特定的热点区域。
AI.method: 将问题表述为一个线性规划（LP）。分析并证明了最坏情况下的负载下界。构造了一个新的无感知负载均衡方案。
AI.result: 确定了最坏情况下的负载下界：当 $1<k \leq N^2/2$ 时约为 $\frac{\sqrt{2k}}{4}$；当 $N^2/2\leq k\leq N^2$ 时为 $\frac{N}{4}$。证明了著名的Valiant负载均衡方案在稀疏流量下并非最优。构造了一个达到该下界的最佳无感知负载均衡方案。发现无感知路由和非无感知路由的最坏情况负载之间存在 $\sqrt{2}$ 的乘性差距。
AI.conclusion: 成功构造了一个在稀疏流量下 $N \times N$ 环面网络中达到理论下界的最优无感知负载均衡方案，该方案优于现有的Valiant方案，且结果可推广到更一般的环面结构。
AI.translation: 网络中的无感知负载均衡涉及使用独立于流量的预定路径将流量从源路由到目的地，从而使网络中任何链路上的最大负载最小化。我们研究了在稀疏流量下 $N \times N$ 环面网络中的无感知负载均衡方案，其中最多有 $k$ 个活跃的源-目的地对。我们的动机是解决大规模低轨（LEO）卫星网络中的负载均衡问题，该网络可以建模为环面，并且已知其流量是稀疏的并局限于某些热点区域。我们将该问题表述为一个线性规划，并证明了当 $1<k \leq N^2/2$ 时，任何无感知路由方案的最坏情况负载下限约为 $\frac{\sqrt{2k}}{4}$；当 $N^2/2\leq k\leq N^2$ 时，下限为 $\frac{N}{4}$。此外，我们证明了著名的Valiant负载均衡方案在稀疏流量下并非最优，并构建了一个达到该下限的最佳无感知负载均衡方案。我们进一步发现，非无感知路由的最坏情况负载与任何无感知路由的最坏情况负载之间存在 $\sqrt{2}$ 的乘性差距。该结果还可以推广到垂直和水平方向链路容量不等的通用 $N \times M$ 环面。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在稀疏流量（最多 $k$ 对活跃连接）下 $N \times N$ 环面网络（模拟大规模LEO卫星网络）中的无感知负载均衡问题。通过线性规划，作者确定了最坏情况负载的理论下界。研究发现，传统的Valiant负载均衡方案在稀疏流量下表现不佳。作为核心贡献，本文构造了一种达到该理论下界的最佳无感知负载均衡方案，并量化了无感知路由与非无感知路由在最坏情况负载上的性能差距 ($\sqrt{2}$ 倍)。
AI.keywords: 无感知负载均衡, LEO卫星网络, 稀疏流量, 环面网络
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将理论上的无感知负载均衡研究与实际的大规模低轨卫星网络应用紧密结合，特别是考虑了稀疏流量这一特定的现实约束。通过建立严格的理论下界并构造出达到该下界的最佳方案，解决了在资源受限且流量模式不确定的动态网络中实现高效路由的关键挑战。这项工作对于优化未来卫星网络的吞吐量和稳定性具有重要意义。

title: IBISAgent: Reinforcing Pixel-Level Visual Reasoning in MLLMs for Universal Biomedical Object Referring and Segmentation
summary: Recent research on medical MLLMs has gradually shifted its focus from image-level understanding to fine-grained, pixel-level comprehension. Although segmentation serves as the foundation for pixel-level understanding, existing approaches face two major challenges. First, they introduce implicit segmentation tokens and require simultaneous fine-tuning of both the MLLM and external pixel decoders, which increases the risk of catastrophic forgetting and limits generalization to out-of-domain scenarios. Second, most methods rely on single-pass reasoning and lack the capability to iteratively refine segmentation results, leading to suboptimal performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose a novel agentic MLLM, named IBISAgent, that reformulates segmentation as a vision-centric, multi-step decision-making process. IBISAgent enables MLLMs to generate interleaved reasoning and text-based click actions, invoke segmentation tools, and produce high-quality masks without architectural modifications. By iteratively performing multi-step visual reasoning on masked image features, IBISAgent naturally supports mask refinement and promotes the development of pixel-level visual reasoning capabilities. We further design a two-stage training framework consisting of cold-start supervised fine-tuning and agentic reinforcement learning with tailored, fine-grained rewards, enhancing the model's robustness in complex medical referring and reasoning segmentation tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IBISAgent consistently outperforms both closed-source and open-source SOTA methods. All datasets, code, and trained models will be released publicly.

AI.title_translation: IBISAgent：在多模态大语言模型中强化像素级视觉推理以实现通用生物医学对象指代和分割
AI.tldr: 针对现有医学多模态大模型在像素级分割中存在的灾难性遗忘和缺乏迭代优化的问题，本文提出了IBISAgent，一个将分割重构为多步决策过程的智能体多模态大模型。它通过交错推理和基于文本的点击动作来迭代优化分割结果，并在医学对象指代和分割任务中取得了优于SOTA的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的医学多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在像素级理解方面面临两大挑战：1) 引入隐式分割标记并同时微调MLLM和外部像素解码器，导致灾难性遗忘风险增加，泛化能力受限；2) 依赖单次推理，缺乏迭代优化分割结果的能力，导致性能不理想。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为IBISAgent的新型智能体多模态大语言模型（MLLM）。该模型将分割重构为以视觉为中心的多步决策过程。它使MLLM能够生成交错的推理和基于文本的点击动作，调用分割工具，并无需修改架构即可生成高质量掩码。通过在掩蔽图像特征上迭代执行多步视觉推理，IBISAgent自然支持掩码优化。此外，设计了一个两阶段训练框架：冷启动监督微调和带有定制化细粒度奖励的智能体强化学习。
AI.result: 广泛的实验证明，IBISAgent持续优于闭源和开源的SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: IBISAgent通过将分割重构为多步决策过程，并结合强化学习训练，成功克服了现有医学多模态大模型在像素级分割中的局限性，实现了对复杂医学指代和推理分割任务的鲁棒性提升和SOTA性能。
AI.translation: 近期关于医学多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的研究已逐渐将焦点从图像级理解转向细粒度的像素级理解。尽管分割是像素级理解的基础，但现有方法面临两大挑战。首先，它们引入了隐式分割标记，并需要同时对MLLM和外部像素解码器进行微调，这增加了灾难性遗忘的风险并限制了对域外场景的泛化能力。其次，大多数方法依赖于单次推理，缺乏迭代细化分割结果的能力，导致性能不理想。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种新型的智能体MLLM，名为IBISAgent，它将分割重构为一个以视觉为中心的多步决策过程。IBISAgent使MLLMs能够生成交错的推理和基于文本的点击动作，调用分割工具，并在不修改架构的情况下生成高质量掩码。通过在掩蔽图像特征上迭代执行多步视觉推理，IBISAgent自然支持掩码优化，并促进像素级视觉推理能力的发展。我们进一步设计了一个两阶段训练框架，包括冷启动监督微调和带有定制化细粒度奖励的智能体强化学习，从而增强了模型在复杂医学指代和推理分割任务中的鲁棒性。广泛的实验证明，IBISAgent持续优于闭源和开源的SOTA方法。所有数据集、代码和训练模型都将公开发布。
AI.summary: 本文提出IBISAgent，一个针对医学多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的智能体框架，旨在解决现有像素级分割方法中存在的灾难性遗忘和缺乏迭代优化的问题。IBISAgent将分割任务重构为多步视觉推理和决策过程，通过生成推理和文本点击动作来调用分割工具，并支持迭代的掩码优化，无需修改模型架构。通过结合冷启动监督微调和智能体强化学习的两阶段训练，IBISAgent显著提升了模型在通用生物医学对象指代和分割任务中的鲁棒性和性能，超越了现有SOTA方法。
AI.keywords: MLLM, 像素级视觉推理, 智能体（Agent）, 生物医学分割, 强化学习
AI.comments: IBISAgent的创新之处在于将传统的像素级分割任务转化为一个基于智能体的、可迭代优化的多步决策过程。这种方法避免了对MLLM架构进行侵入式修改，并通过文本驱动的点击动作与外部工具交互，有效缓解了传统方法中MLLM和像素解码器联合微调导致的灾难性遗忘问题。特别是在医疗领域，对精度和可解释性的高要求使得这种支持迭代推理和细化分割结果的机制（类似于人类专家对图像的逐步分析）显得尤为重要，极大地增强了模型的泛化能力和鲁棒性。

title: StealthGraph: Exposing Domain-Specific Risks in LLMs through Knowledge-Graph-Guided Harmful Prompt Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied in specialized domains such as finance and healthcare, where they introduce unique safety risks. Domain-specific datasets of harmful prompts remain scarce and still largely rely on manual construction; public datasets mainly focus on explicit harmful prompts, which modern LLM defenses can often detect and refuse. In contrast, implicit harmful prompts-expressed through indirect domain knowledge-are harder to detect and better reflect real-world threats. We identify two challenges: transforming domain knowledge into actionable constraints and increasing the implicitness of generated harmful prompts. To address them, we propose an end-to-end framework that first performs knowledge-graph-guided harmful prompt generation to systematically produce domain-relevant prompts, and then applies dual-path obfuscation rewriting to convert explicit harmful prompts into implicit variants via direct and context-enhanced rewriting. This framework yields high-quality datasets combining strong domain relevance with implicitness, enabling more realistic red-teaming and advancing LLM safety research. We release our code and datasets at GitHub.

AI.title_translation: StealthGraph：通过知识图谱指导的有害提示生成来揭示LLM中的领域特定风险
AI.tldr: 为了应对LLM在专业领域中因隐性有害提示带来的安全风险，StealthGraph框架使用知识图谱来生成领域相关的有害提示，并利用双路径混淆重写技术将它们转化为隐蔽的提示，以创建更真实的红队测试数据集。
AI.motivation: LLMs在金融和医疗等专业领域应用带来独特的安全风险；领域特定的有害提示数据集稀缺且依赖人工构建；现有公开数据集侧重于容易被检测和拒绝的显式有害提示，而反映现实威胁的隐式有害提示（通过间接领域知识表达）更难检测。主要挑战在于将领域知识转化为可操作的约束以及增加生成有害提示的隐蔽性。
AI.method: 提出一个端到端的框架，首先通过知识图谱引导的有害提示生成来系统地产生领域相关提示，然后应用双路径混淆重写（直接和上下文增强重写）将显式有害提示转换为隐式变体。
AI.result: 该框架生成了结合强领域相关性与隐蔽性的高质量数据集，能够支持更现实的红队测试。
AI.conclusion: 该框架生成了结合强领域相关性和隐蔽性的高质量数据集，有助于更真实的红队测试并推进LLM安全研究。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地应用于金融和医疗等专业领域，带来了独特的安全风险。领域特定的有害提示数据集仍然稀缺，并且在很大程度上依赖于人工构建；公开数据集主要关注现代LLM防御通常可以检测和拒绝的显式有害提示。相比之下，通过间接领域知识表达的隐式有害提示更难检测，更能反映现实世界的威胁。我们确定了两个挑战：将领域知识转化为可操作的约束和增加生成有害提示的隐蔽性。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一个端到端的框架，该框架首先通过知识图谱引导的有害提示生成来系统地生成领域相关的提示，然后应用双路径混淆重写技术，通过直接和上下文增强的重写将显式有害提示转换为隐式变体。该框架产生了结合强领域相关性和隐蔽性的高质量数据集，支持更真实的红队测试并推进LLM安全研究。我们将在GitHub上发布代码和数据集。
AI.summary: 本文提出了StealthGraph框架，旨在解决在专业领域中LLM面临的独特安全风险。该框架利用知识图谱指导生成具有领域相关性的有害提示，并通过双路径混淆重写技术将这些提示转化为更难检测的隐式变体，从而创建高质量、高隐蔽性的数据集以促进更真实的LLM红队测试和安全研究。
AI.keywords: LLMs, 知识图谱, 有害提示生成, 领域特定风险, 隐蔽性
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于结合知识图谱（Knowledge Graph）来系统性地生成具有领域特定性和隐蔽性的有害提示，并引入了双路径混淆重写技术以增强提示的隐蔽性，这对于更贴近现实世界的红队测试和LLM安全研究具有重要意义。其局限性可能在于对知识图谱构建和维护的依赖性。

title: DAVOS: An Autonomous Vehicle Operating System in the Vehicle Computing Era
summary: Vehicle computing represents a fundamental shift in how autonomous vehicles are designed and deployed, transforming them from isolated transportation systems into mobile computing platforms that support both safety-critical, real-time driving and data-centric services. In this setting, vehicles simultaneously support real-time driving pipelines and a growing set of data-driven applications, placing increased responsibility on the vehicle operating system to coordinate computation, data movement, storage, and access. These demands highlight recurring system considerations related to predictable execution, data and execution protection, efficient handling of high-rate sensor data, and long-term system evolvability, commonly summarized as Safety, Security, Efficiency, and Extensibility (SSEE). Existing vehicle operating systems and runtimes address these concerns in isolation, resulting in fragmented software stacks that limit coordination between autonomy workloads and vehicle data services. This paper presents DAVOS, the Dependable Autonomous Vehicle Operating System, a unified vehicle operating system architecture designed for the vehicle computing context. DAVOS provides a cohesive operating system foundation that supports both real-time autonomy and extensible vehicle computing within a single system framework.

AI.title_translation: DAVOS：汽车计算时代的自动驾驶汽车操作系统
AI.tldr: DAVOS是一个统一的车辆操作系统架构，旨在解决当前车辆操作系统在安全、数据处理和可扩展性方面的不足，以应对汽车计算时代的挑战。
AI.motivation: 当前的车辆操作系统在处理实时驾驶和数据驱动应用方面存在碎片化问题，未能有效协调自动驾驶工作负载和车辆数据服务，需要一个统一的系统来满足安全、安全、效率和可扩展性的要求。
AI.method: 提出DAVOS（Dependable Autonomous Vehicle Operating System），一个统一的车辆操作系统架构，为实时自动驾驶和可扩展的车辆计算提供了一个集成的系统框架。
AI.result: DAVOS提供了一个统一的操作系统基础，可以在单一系统框架内支持实时自动驾驶和可扩展的车辆计算。
AI.conclusion: DAVOS是一个面向汽车计算时代、统一的自动驾驶车辆操作系统架构，能够满足实时驾驶和数据驱动应用的需求。
AI.translation: 车辆计算代表了自动驾驶汽车设计和部署的根本性转变，将它们从孤立的交通系统转变为支持安全关键、实时驾驶和数据驱动服务的移动计算平台。在这种环境下，车辆同时支持实时驾驶管道和越来越多的数据驱动应用程序，这增加了车辆操作系统在协调计算、数据移动、存储和访问方面的责任。这些需求凸显了与可预测执行、数据和执行保护、高效处理高比特率传感器数据以及长期系统可演化性相关的经常性系统考虑因素，通常概括为安全、安全、效率和可扩展性（SSEE）。现有的车辆操作系统和运行时分别处理这些问题，导致软件堆栈碎片化，限制了自动驾驶工作负载和车辆数据服务之间的协调。本文提出了DAVOS，即可靠的自动驾驶车辆操作系统，这是一个统一的车辆操作系统架构，专为车辆计算环境而设计。DAVOS提供了一个统一的操作系统基础，可以在单一系统框架内支持实时自动驾驶和可扩展的车辆计算。
AI.summary: DAVOS是一个新提出的、统一的自动驾驶车辆操作系统（Dependable Autonomous Vehicle Operating System），旨在解决当前车辆计算时代面临的挑战。它通过提供一个集成的系统框架，有效地协调实时驾驶和数据驱动应用程序，解决了现有操作系统在安全、数据处理和可扩展性方面的不足。
AI.keywords: 自动驾驶汽车操作系统, 车辆计算, DAVOS, 实时系统, 可扩展性
AI.comments: DAVOS的提出对于解决当前自动驾驶汽车领域操作系统碎片化的问题具有重要意义。它通过统一的架构，有望提升系统的整体性能和可靠性，但其实际效果仍需通过大规模部署和测试来验证。

title: GlueNN: gluing patchwise analytic solutions with neural networks
summary: In the analysis of complex physical systems, the objective often extends beyond merely computing a numerical solution to capturing the precise crossover between different regimes and extracting parameters containing meaningful information. However, standard numerical solvers and conventional deep learning approaches, such as Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), typically operate as black boxes that output solution fields without disentangling the solution into its interpretable constituent parts. In this work, we propose GlueNN, a physics-informed learning framework that decomposes the global solution into interpretable, patchwise analytic components. Rather than approximating the solution directly, GlueNN promotes the integration constants of local asymptotic expansions to learnable, scale-dependent coefficient functions. By constraining these coefficients with the differential equation, the network effectively performs regime transition, smoothly interpolating between asymptotic limits without requiring ad hoc boundary matching. We demonstrate that this coefficient-centric approach reproduces accurate global solutions in various examples and thus directly extracts physical information that is not explicitly available through standard numerical integration.

AI.title_translation: GlueNN：用神经网络粘合分块解析解
AI.tldr: GlueNN是一种新的物理学习框架，它不直接学习解，而是学习解的组成部分的“连接常数”（积分常数），从而将复杂的物理解分解成可解释的部分，并能自动、平滑地在不同物理区域间过渡，直接给出有意义的物理参数。
AI.motivation: 在复杂物理系统的分析中，目标不仅是计算数值解，更重要的是捕捉不同物理机制之间的精确交叉点，并提取包含有意义信息的参数。传统的数值求解器和深度学习方法（如PINNs）通常是黑箱，无法将解分离成可解释的组成部分。
AI.method: GlueNN框架通过将全局解分解为可解释的、分块的解析组件，并推广局部渐近展开的积分常数为可学习的、尺度依赖的系数函数。通过用微分方程约束这些系数，网络可以有效地执行“机制转换”，在渐近极限之间平滑插值，而无需人为设置的边界匹配。
AI.result: 这种系数为中心的学习方法能够重现准确的全局解，并直接提取出传统数值积分方法无法显式提供的物理信息。
AI.conclusion: GlueNN这种以系数为中心的学习方法能够重现准确的全局解，并直接提取出传统数值积分方法无法显式提供的物理信息。
AI.translation: 在复杂物理系统的分析中，目标往往超出了仅仅计算数值解，还包括捕获不同机制之间精确的交叉点，并提取包含有意义信息的参数。然而，标准的数值求解器和传统深度学习方法，例如物理信息神经网络（PINNs），通常作为黑箱运行，输出解场而不能将解分解成其可解释的组成部分。在这项工作中，我们提出了GlueNN，一个物理信息学习框架，它将全局解分解为可解释的、分块的解析组件。GlueNN不是直接近似解，而是将局部渐近展开的积分常数推广为可学习的、尺度依赖的系数函数。通过用微分方程约束这些系数，网络有效地执行了“机制转换”，在渐近极限之间平滑插值，而无需人为设置的边界匹配。我们证明了这种以系数为中心的做法能够重现各种示例中的准确全局解，从而直接提取出标准数值积分无法显式提供的物理信息。
AI.summary: GlueNN是一个物理信息学习框架，它通过将全局解分解为可解释的、分块的解析组件来解决传统数值和深度学习方法缺乏可解释性的问题。该方法通过学习局部渐近展开的积分常数作为尺度依赖的系数函数，并用微分方程约束这些系数，从而实现了不同物理机制之间的平滑过渡和插值，无需人工边界匹配，并能直接提取物理信息。
AI.keywords: 物理信息学习, 解析解, 神经网络, 积分常数, 渐近展开
AI.comments: GlueNN的创新点在于它不是直接近似解，而是将解分解为可解释的、分块的解析组件，并通过学习积分常数来实现不同物理机制之间的平滑过渡，这比传统的黑箱方法（如PINNs）更具可解释性。其重要性在于它能直接提取物理信息，解决了传统方法中难以捕捉不同物理机制交叉点的问题。局限性方面，摘要中未提及明显的局限性。

title: Revisiting the Ordering of Channel and Spatial Attention: A Comprehensive Study on Sequential and Parallel Designs
summary: Attention mechanisms have become a core component of deep learning models, with Channel Attention and Spatial Attention being the two most representative architectures. Current research on their fusion strategies primarily bifurcates into sequential and parallel paradigms, yet the selection process remains largely empirical, lacking systematic analysis and unified principles. We systematically compare channel-spatial attention combinations under a unified framework, building an evaluation suite of 18 topologies across four classes: sequential, parallel, multi-scale, and residual. Across two vision and nine medical datasets, we uncover a "data scale-method-performance" coupling law: (1) in few-shot tasks, the "Channel-Multi-scale Spatial" cascaded structure achieves optimal performance; (2) in medium-scale tasks, parallel learnable fusion architectures demonstrate superior results; (3) in large-scale tasks, parallel structures with dynamic gating yield the best performance. Additionally, experiments indicate that the "Spatial-Channel" order is more stable and effective for fine-grained classification, while residual connections mitigate vanishing gradient problems across varying data scales. We thus propose scenario-based guidelines for building future attention modules. Code is open-sourced at https://github.com/DWlzm.

AI.title_translation: 重新审视通道和空间注意力的顺序：一项关于顺序和并行设计的综合研究
AI.tldr: 研究比较了不同通道和空间注意力组合（顺序、并行、多尺度、残差）在不同数据规模下的表现，提出了基于数据规模和任务类型的注意力模块设计指南。
AI.motivation: 现有研究在融合通道注意力和空间注意力时，主要采用顺序和并行两种范式，但缺乏系统的分析和统一的原则来指导选择。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含18种拓扑结构的评估套件，涵盖顺序、并行、多尺度和残差四类，并在两个视觉和九个医学数据集上进行了系统比较。
AI.result: 发现“数据规模-方法-性能”的耦合规律：在少样本任务中，“通道-多尺度空间”级联结构表现最佳；在中等规模任务中，并行可学习融合架构效果更优；在大规模任务中，具有动态门控的并行结构表现最好。另外，“空间-通道”顺序在细粒度分类任务中更稳定有效，残差连接有助于缓解梯度消失问题。
AI.conclusion: 基于实验结果，提出了针对不同场景（数据规模和任务类型）构建未来注意力模块的指导方针。
AI.translation: 注意力机制已成为深度学习模型的核心组成部分，其中通道注意力和空间注意力是两个最具代表性的架构。目前对它们融合策略的研究主要分为顺序和并行两种范式，但选择过程在很大程度上是凭经验的，缺乏系统的分析和统一的原则。我们通过一个统一的框架系统地比较了通道-空间注意力组合，构建了一个包含18种拓扑结构的评估套件，涵盖顺序、并行、多尺度和残差四类。在两个视觉和九个医学数据集上，我们揭示了“数据规模-方法-性能”的耦合规律：(1)在少样本任务中，“通道-多尺度空间”级联结构实现了最佳性能；(2)在中等规模任务中，并行可学习融合架构表现出更优越的结果；(3)在大规模任务中，具有动态门控的并行结构取得了最好的性能。此外，实验表明“空间-通道”顺序对于细粒度分类更稳定有效，而残差连接有助于缓解不同数据规模下的梯度消失问题。因此，我们提出了基于场景的指南来构建未来的注意力模块。代码已开源：https://github.com/DWlzm。
AI.summary: 本研究系统地比较了通道注意力和空间注意力模块的顺序和并行融合设计，并在不同规模的数据集上进行了评估。研究发现，最佳设计取决于数据规模：少样本任务适合“通道-多尺度空间”级联结构，中等规模任务适合并行可学习融合架构，大规模任务则适合带动态门控的并行结构。此外，“空间-通道”顺序在细粒度分类任务中表现更优，残差连接有助于提高模型稳定性。研究提出了基于场景的注意力模块设计指南。
AI.keywords: 通道注意力,空间注意力,顺序设计,并行设计,数据规模
AI.comments: 这项研究具有重要的理论和实践意义。它通过系统的实验揭示了注意力机制融合设计的“数据规模-方法-性能”耦合规律，为实际应用中如何选择和设计注意力模块提供了明确的指导。研究提出的基于场景的设计指南，有助于研究人员和工程师更有效地利用注意力机制，提升模型性能。代码开源也方便了后续研究和应用。

title: Emergent Coordination in Multi-Agent Systems via Pressure Fields and Temporal Decay
comments: 27 pages, 5 figures, 12 tables. Code available at https://github.com/Govcraft/pressure-field-experiment
summary: Current multi-agent LLM frameworks rely on explicit orchestration patterns borrowed from human organizational structures: planners delegate to executors, managers coordinate workers, and hierarchical control flow governs agent interactions. These approaches suffer from coordination overhead that scales poorly with agent count and task complexity. We propose a fundamentally different paradigm inspired by natural coordination mechanisms: agents operate locally on a shared artifact, guided only by pressure gradients derived from measurable quality signals, with temporal decay preventing premature convergence. We formalize this as optimization over a pressure landscape and prove convergence guarantees under mild conditions. Empirically, on meeting room scheduling across 1,350 trials, pressure-field coordination outperforms all baselines: 48.5% aggregate solve rate versus 12.6% for conversation-based coordination, 1.5% for hierarchical control, and 0.4% for sequential and random baselines (all pairwise comparisons p < 0.001). Temporal decay is essential: disabling it reduces solve rate by 10 percentage points. On easy problems, pressure-field achieves 86.7% solve rate. The approach maintains consistent performance from 1 to 4 agents. Implicit coordination through shared pressure gradients outperforms explicit hierarchical control, suggesting that constraint-driven emergence offers a simpler and more effective foundation for multi-agent AI.
comment: 27 pages, 5 figures, 12 tables. Code available at https://github.com/Govcraft/pressure-field-experiment

AI.title_translation: 多智能体系统通过压力场和时间衰减实现涌现协调
AI.tldr: 提出一种新的多智能体协调范式，利用局部压力场和时间衰减，无需显式协调，并在会议室调度任务中取得显著优于现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的多智能体LLM框架依赖于显式协调模式，这些模式会随着智能体数量和任务复杂度的增加而导致协调开销不成比例地增长。
AI.method: 提出一种受自然协调机制启发的范式：智能体在共享产物上进行局部操作，仅受可衡量质量信号导出的压力梯度指导，并结合时间衰减以防止过早收敛。将此形式化为压力场上的优化，并证明了在温和条件下的收敛性。
AI.result: 在涉及1350次试验的会议室调度任务中，压力场协调的总体解决率为48.5%，显著优于基于对话的协调（12.6%）、分层控制（1.5%）和顺序/随机基线（0.4%）。时间衰减至关重要，禁用它会使解决率降低10个百分点。在简单问题上，压力场可达到86.7%的解决率。该方法在1到4个智能体之间保持一致的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享压力梯度进行的隐式协调优于显式分层控制，表明受约束驱动的涌现为多智能体AI提供了更简单、更有效的根基。
AI.translation: 当前的多智能体LLM框架依赖于借鉴人类组织结构的显式编排模式：规划者委托给执行者，管理者协调工作者，以及分层控制流控制智能体交互。这些方法受到协调开销的困扰，这种开销随着智能体数量和任务复杂度的增加而难以扩展。我们提出一种根本不同的范式，其灵感来自自然的协调机制：智能体在共享的产物上进行局部操作，仅受来自可衡量质量信号的压力梯度指导，并具有时间衰减以防止过早收敛。我们将此形式化为在压力场上的优化，并在温和的条件下证明了收敛性保证。在经验上，涉及1350次试验的会议室调度任务中，压力场协调的表现优于所有基线：与基于对话的协调的12.6%、分层控制的1.5%以及顺序和随机基线的0.4%相比，总体解决率为48.5%（所有成对比较p < 0.001）。时间衰减是必不可少的：禁用它会使解决率降低10个百分点。在简单问题上，压力场可达到86.7%的解决率。该方法在1到4个智能体之间保持一致的性能。通过共享压力梯度的隐式协调优于显式分层控制，这表明受约束驱动的涌现为多智能体AI提供了更简单、更有效的根基。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的多智能体协调范式，摒弃了传统的显式协调模式，转而采用受自然启发的“压力场”方法。智能体仅根据局部质量信号产生的压力梯度进行操作，并辅以时间衰减防止过早收敛。实验结果表明，该方法在会议室调度任务中取得了显著的性能提升，远超现有基线，并证明了该范式在扩展性和效率方面的优势。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统, 协调, 压力场, 时间衰减, 隐式协调
AI.comments: 这项研究提出了一个有趣的新范式，用于解决多智能体系统中的协调问题，特别是针对大型语言模型。通过利用“压力场”和“时间衰减”的概念，该方法似乎能够有效地实现隐式协调，避免了传统显式协调机制的瓶颈。该方法在实验中表现出的优越性能令人印象深刻，尤其是在大规模试验和不同智能体数量下的稳定性。然而，进一步研究其在更广泛任务类型和不同类型智能体上的适用性，以及对“压力场”和“时间衰减”机制更深入的理论分析，将有助于巩固其作为一种通用解决方案的地位。此外，理解这种隐式协调如何处理更复杂的、可能存在冲突的目标将是一个重要的后续方向。

title: Controlled LLM Training on Spectral Sphere
summary: Scaling large models requires optimization strategies that ensure rapid convergence grounded in stability. Maximal Update Parametrization ($\boldsymbolμ$P) provides a theoretical safeguard for width-invariant $Θ(1)$ activation control, whereas emerging optimizers like Muon are only ``half-aligned'' with these constraints: they control updates but allow weights to drift. To address this limitation, we introduce the \textbf{Spectral Sphere Optimizer (SSO)}, which enforces strict module-wise spectral constraints on both weights and their updates. By deriving the steepest descent direction on the spectral sphere, SSO realizes a fully $\boldsymbolμ$P-aligned optimization process. To enable large-scale training, we implement SSO as an efficient parallel algorithm within Megatron. Through extensive pretraining on diverse architectures, including Dense 1.7B, MoE 8B-A1B, and 200-layer DeepNet models, SSO consistently outperforms AdamW and Muon. Furthermore, we observe significant practical stability benefits, including improved MoE router load balancing, suppressed outliers, and strictly bounded activations.

AI.title_translation: 受控大语言模型在谱球上的训练
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了谱球优化器（SSO），一种能够严格控制权重和更新的谱范数，从而实现完全μP对齐的优化过程，解决了现有优化器（如Muon）只控制更新而不控制权重漂移的问题。SSO作为一种高效的并行算法集成到Megatron中，在多种模型和任务上均优于AdamW和Muon，并带来了稳定性上的显著提升，包括MoE路由器的负载均衡、异常值抑制和激活值界限的严格控制。
AI.motivation: 现有的优化器（如Muon）在训练大模型时，虽然能控制权重更新，但允许权重发生漂移，与最大更新参数化（μP）理论的要求存在偏差，限制了模型的稳定性和收敛速度。因此，需要一种新的优化方法来严格控制权重和更新，以实现μP对齐，并支持大规模模型的稳定训练。
AI.method: 提出谱球优化器（SSO），它通过在权重和更新上强制执行严格的模块化谱范数约束，并在谱球上推导出最陡下降方向，从而实现完全μP对齐的优化。SSO被实现为Megatron中的一种高效并行算法，用于大规模预训练。
AI.result: 在Dense 1.7B、MoE 8B-A1B和200层DeepNet等多种模型上进行的大规模预训练表明，SSO的性能持续优于AdamW和Muon。此外，SSO在实际应用中带来了显著的稳定性优势，包括改善MoE路由器的负载均衡、抑制异常值以及严格限制激活值的范围。
AI.conclusion: 谱球优化器（SSO）通过在权重和更新上强制执行严格的谱范数约束，实现了完全μP对齐的优化，解决了现有优化器的问题。SSO作为一种高效的并行算法，在各种模型规模和类型上都展现出优越的性能和稳定性，为大模型的高效、稳定训练提供了新的解决方案。
AI.translation: 为了实现大模型的扩展，需要优化策略来确保快速收敛并保持稳定性。最大更新参数化（μP）为宽度不变的Θ(1)激活控制提供了理论保障，而像Muon这样的新兴优化器仅与这些约束“半对齐”：它们控制更新，但允许权重漂移。为了解决这个限制，我们引入了谱球优化器（SSO），它强制对权重及其更新进行严格的模块化谱约束。通过在谱球上推导最陡下降方向，SSO实现了完全μP对齐的优化过程。为了实现大规模训练，我们将SSO作为一种高效的并行算法集成到Megatron中。通过在各种架构（包括Dense 1.7B、MoE 8B-A1B和200层DeepNet模型）上进行广泛的预训练，SSO的性能持续优于AdamW和Muon。此外，我们观察到显著的实际稳定性优势，包括改进的MoE路由器负载均衡、抑制异常值以及严格限制激活值。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了谱球优化器（SSO），一种能够严格控制权重和更新的谱范数，从而实现完全μP对齐的优化过程，解决了现有优化器（如Muon）只控制更新而不控制权重漂移的问题。SSO作为一种高效的并行算法集成到Megatron中，在多种模型和任务上均优于AdamW和Muon，并带来了稳定性上的显著提升，包括MoE路由器的负载均衡、异常值抑制和激活值界限的严格控制。
AI.keywords: 谱球优化器,大模型训练,μP对齐,模型稳定性,Megatron
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的优化器SSO，通过在谱球上进行优化来解决大模型训练中的稳定性问题，并取得了优于现有方法的性能。其理论基础扎实，并且在实际大规模训练中得到了验证，尤其在MoE模型上的稳定性提升值得关注。未来的工作可以进一步探索SSO在其他类型的大模型训练任务中的应用潜力。

title: Optimising for Energy Efficiency and Performance in Machine Learning
summary:
The ubiquity of machine learning (ML) and the demand for ever-larger models bring an increase in energy consumption and environmental impact. However, little is known about the energy scaling laws in ML, and existing research focuses on training cost -- ignoring the larger cost of inference. Furthermore, tools for measuring the energy consumption of ML do not provide actionable feedback.
  To address these gaps, we developed Energy Consumption Optimiser (ECOpt): a hyperparameter tuner that optimises for energy efficiency and model performance. ECOpt quantifies the trade-off between these metrics as an interpretable Pareto frontier. This enables ML practitioners to make informed decisions about energy cost and environmental impact, while maximising the benefit of their models and complying with new regulations.
  Using ECOpt, we show that parameter and floating-point operation counts can be unreliable proxies for energy consumption, and observe that the energy efficiency of Transformer models for text generation is relatively consistent across hardware. These findings motivate measuring and publishing the energy metrics of ML models. We further show that ECOpt can have a net positive environmental impact and use it to uncover seven models for CIFAR-10 that improve upon the state of the art, when considering accuracy and energy efficiency together.

AI.title_translation: 机器学习中的能源效率和性能优化
AI.tldr: 机器学习模型消耗大量能源，但对其能源消耗规律的研究不足，且现有工具缺乏可操作的反馈。ECOpt是一个超参数调整器，可优化能源效率和模型性能，并量化两者之间的权衡，帮助从业者做出明智决策。研究表明，参数和浮点运算次数不能可靠地预测能耗，Transformer模型的能效在不同硬件上相对一致。ECOpt可带来净积极的环境效益，并已用于发现七个在准确性和能效方面均优于现有技术的CIFAR-10模型。
AI.motivation: 机器学习的普及和模型规模的增大导致能源消耗和环境影响增加，但现有研究对机器学习的能源缩放规律了解不足，且忽视了推理成本。此外，用于测量机器学习能耗的工具缺乏可操作的反馈。
AI.method: 开发了一个名为ECOpt的超参数调整器，用于优化能源效率和模型性能，并量化这两个指标之间的权衡，形成可解释的帕累托前沿。
AI.result: ECOpt能够量化能源效率和模型性能之间的权衡，形成可解释的帕累托前沿。研究表明，参数数量和浮点运算次数是不可靠的能源消耗代理指标。Transformer模型在文本生成任务上的能效在不同硬件上表现出一致性。ECOpt有助于实现净积极的环境效益，并发现了七个在CIFAR-10数据集上同时提高准确性和能效的先进模型。
AI.conclusion: ECOpt是一个有效的工具，可以帮助机器学习从业者在优化模型性能的同时，做出关于能源消耗和环境影响的明智决策。研究结果强调了测量和发布机器学习模型能源指标的重要性，并展示了ECOpt在发现更节能和高性能模型方面的潜力。
AI.translation:
机器学习（ML）的普及以及对更大模型的需求导致能源消耗和环境影响增加。然而，人们对ML中的能源缩放规律知之甚少，现有研究侧重于训练成本——忽略了推理成本这一更大的成本。此外，用于测量ML能耗的工具未能提供可操作的反馈。
为了解决这些差距，我们开发了能源消耗优化器（ECOpt）：一个优化能源效率和模型性能的超参数调整器。ECOpt将这些指标之间的权衡量化为可解释的帕累托前沿。这使得ML从业者能够在最大化模型效益和遵守新法规的同时，就能源成本和环境影响做出明智的决策。
使用ECOpt，我们证明了参数数量和浮点运算次数可以作为能源消耗的不可靠代理，并观察到用于文本生成的Transformer模型的能源效率在不同硬件上相对一致。这些发现促使人们测量和发布ML模型的能源指标。我们进一步证明ECOpt可以产生净积极的环境效益，并利用它发现了CIFAR-10的七个模型，这些模型在同时考虑准确性和能源效率时优于现有技术。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种名为ECOpt的工具，旨在解决机器学习模型日益增长的能源消耗和环境影响问题。ECOpt是一个超参数调整器，能够同时优化模型的能源效率和性能，并以帕累托前沿的形式直观地展示两者之间的权衡。研究发现，传统的性能指标（如参数数量和浮点运算次数）不能准确反映能源消耗，并且Transformer模型的能效在不同硬件上相对稳定。ECOpt不仅有助于做出更明智的决策以应对环境挑战和法规要求，还能带来实际的环境效益，并已成功用于发现性能和能效俱佳的新模型。
AI.keywords: 机器学习, 能源效率, 模型性能, ECOpt, 帕累托前沿
AI.comments: 该研究解决了机器学习领域一个日益重要的问题：能源消耗和环境影响。ECOpt工具的开发及其在量化性能与能效权衡方面的能力是一个重要的贡献。然而，文中提到“相对一致”的能效在不同硬件上的具体表现，以及ECOpt在实际大规模部署中的可扩展性和效率仍有待进一步探讨。此外，将ECOpt集成到现有的ML工作流程中的便利性也是一个值得关注的方面。

title: Programming over Thinking: Efficient and Robust Multi-Constraint Planning
comments: 8 pages of main text, 2 pages of references and and limitations, 37 pages of appendices
summary: Multi-constraint planning involves identifying, evaluating, and refining candidate plans while satisfying multiple, potentially conflicting constraints. Existing large language model (LLM) approaches face fundamental limitations in this domain. Pure reasoning paradigms, which rely on long natural language chains, are prone to inconsistency, error accumulation, and prohibitive cost as constraints compound. Conversely, LLMs combined with coding- or solver-based strategies lack flexibility: they often generate problem-specific code from scratch or depend on fixed solvers, failing to capture generalizable logic across diverse problems. To address these challenges, we introduce the Scalable COde Planning Engine (SCOPE), a framework that disentangles query-specific reasoning from generic code execution. By separating reasoning from execution, SCOPE produces solver functions that are consistent, deterministic, and reusable across queries while requiring only minimal changes to input parameters. SCOPE achieves state-of-the-art performance while lowering cost and latency. For example, with GPT-4o, it reaches 93.1% success on TravelPlanner, a 61.6% gain over the best baseline (CoT) while cutting inference cost by 1.4x and time by ~4.67x. Code is available at https://github.com/DerrickGXD/SCOPE.
comment: 8 pages of main text, 2 pages of references and and limitations, 37 pages of appendices

AI.title_translation: 编程而非思考：高效且鲁棒的多约束规划
AI.tldr: 现有大语言模型（LLM）在多约束规划中存在不足：纯粹的推理方法容易出错且成本高，而结合代码/求解器的策略则缺乏灵活性。本文提出的SCOPE框架将推理与代码执行分离，生成一致、可复用的求解器函数，实现了最先进的性能，同时降低了成本和延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型（LLM）在处理多约束规划时存在局限性，纯粹的推理方法容易出错且成本高昂，而结合代码/求解器的策略则不够灵活，难以处理通用问题。
AI.method: 提出SCOPE（Scalable COde Planning Engine）框架，将查询相关的推理与通用的代码执行分离开来，生成一致、确定性、可跨查询复用的求解器函数。
AI.result: 在TravelPlanner基准测试中，使用GPT-4o的SCOPE达到了93.1%的成功率，比最佳基线（CoT）提高了61.6%，同时推理成本降低了1.4倍，时间缩短了约4.67倍。
AI.conclusion: SCOPE框架通过将推理与执行分离，有效解决了现有LLM在多约束规划中的挑战，实现了高性能、低成本和低延迟。
AI.translation: 多约束规划涉及识别、评估和优化候选计划，同时满足多个可能相互冲突的约束。现有的LLM方法在此领域面临根本性限制。纯粹的推理范式依赖于长自然语言链，随着约束的增加，容易出现不一致、误差累积和成本过高的问题。相反，结合了代码或求解器策略的LLM则缺乏灵活性：它们通常从头开始生成特定于问题的代码，或依赖于固定的求解器，无法捕捉跨不同问题的可推广逻辑。为了解决这些挑战，我们引入了SCOPE（Scalable COde Planning Engine）框架，它将查询相关的推理与通用的代码执行分离开来。通过分离推理和执行，SCOPE生成的求解器函数一致、确定性强，并且可以跨查询重复使用，同时只需对输入参数进行微小的更改。SCOPE实现了最先进的性能，同时降低了成本和延迟。例如，使用GPT-4o，它在TravelPlanner上的成功率达到了93.1%，比最佳基线（CoT）提高了61.6%，同时推理成本降低了1.4倍，时间缩短了约4.67倍。代码可在https://github.com/DerrickGXD/SCOPE获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为SCOPE 的新框架，用于解决大语言模型（LLM）在多约束规划中的局限性。SCOPE 将推理过程与代码执行分离开来，从而生成一致、可复用且高效的求解器函数。实验证明，SCOPE 在 TravelPlanner 数据集上取得了显著的性能提升，同时降低了成本和延迟。
AI.keywords: 多约束规划, 大语言模型, 推理与执行分离, SCOPE框架, 求解器函数
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的方法来解决LLM在多约束规划中的挑战，通过分离推理和执行来提高效率和鲁棒性。SCOPE框架的通用性和可复用性是其主要优势。然而，该方法在处理极端复杂或高度动态约束下的表现仍有待进一步验证。

title: Relational Hoare Logic for High-Level Synthesis of Hardware Accelerators
comments: An extended version of the paper to appear in Proceedings of ESOP 2026
summary: High-level synthesis (HLS) is a powerful tool for developing efficient hardware accelerators that rely on specialized memory systems to achieve sufficient on-chip data reuse and off-chip bandwidth utilization. However, even with HLS, designing such systems still requires careful manual tuning, as automatic optimizations provided by existing tools are highly sensitive to programming style and often lack transparency. To address these issues, we present a formal translation framework based on relational Hoare logic, which enables robust and transparent transformations. Our method recognizes complex memory access patterns in naïve HLS programs and automatically transforms them by inserting on-chip buffers to enforce linear access to off-chip memory, and by replacing non-sequential processing with stream processing, while preserving program semantics. Experiments using our prototype translator, combined with an off-the-shelf HLS compiler and a real FPGA board, have demonstrated significant performance improvements.
comment: An extended version of the paper to appear in Proceedings of ESOP 2026

AI.title_translation: 用于硬件加速器高层次综合的关系霍尔逻辑
AI.tldr: 为了解决HLS设计中内存优化依赖手动调整且不透明的问题，研究人员开发了一个基于关系霍尔逻辑的框架，该框架能自动识别并安全地转换复杂的内存访问模式（如插入缓冲和使用流处理），从而在不改变程序含义的情况下显著提升硬件加速器的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的HLS工具在设计依赖于专业内存系统以实现数据重用和带宽利用的硬件加速器时，需要大量手动调整，且自动优化对编程风格敏感且缺乏透明度。
AI.method: 提出一个基于关系霍尔逻辑的形式化翻译框架，该框架能够识别朴素HLS程序中的复杂内存访问模式，并通过自动插入片上缓冲区（以强制对片外存储器的线性访问）和用流处理替换非顺序处理来实现转换，同时保持程序语义。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，使用原型翻译器、现成的HLS编译器和真实FPGA板，实现了显著的性能改进。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，结合原型翻译器、现成的HLS编译器和真实FPGA板，该方法能带来显著的性能提升。
AI.translation: 高层次综合（HLS）是一种强大的工具，用于开发依赖专用内存系统以实现足够片上数据重用和片外带宽利用的高效硬件加速器。然而，即使使用HLS，设计此类系统仍然需要仔细的手动调整，因为现有工具提供的自动优化对编程风格高度敏感，并且通常缺乏透明度。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一个基于关系霍尔逻辑的形式化翻译框架，它支持健壮且透明的转换。我们的方法能够识别朴素HLS程序中的复杂内存访问模式，并通过插入片上缓冲区以强制对片外存储器的线性访问，以及通过用流处理替换非顺序处理来实现自动转换，同时保持程序语义。使用我们的原型翻译器、现成的HLS编译器和真实FPGA板进行的实验证明了显著的性能提升。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了一种基于关系霍尔逻辑的形式化翻译框架，用于解决高层次综合（HLS）中内存系统设计的挑战。该框架能自动识别并转换HLS程序中的复杂内存访问模式，通过引入片上缓冲区和流处理来保证语义不变性，从而实现更健壮、透明的优化，并在实际硬件上验证了显著的性能提升。
AI.keywords: 高层次综合, 关系霍尔逻辑, 内存访问模式, 硬件加速器, 片上缓冲
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于使用关系霍尔逻辑（Relational Hoare Logic）作为形式化框架，实现了对HLS程序的健壮且透明的内存访问模式转换，这解决了现有HLS工具对编程风格的敏感性和缺乏透明性的问题。其重要性在于通过自动化的、语义保持的转换，显著提升了硬件加速器的性能。限制在于，其有效性依赖于对“复杂内存访问模式”的准确识别和转换的正确性。

title: Energy-Entropy Regularization: The True Power of Minimal Looped Transformers
summary: Recent research suggests that looped Transformers have superior reasoning capabilities compared to standard deep architectures. Current approaches to training single-head looped architectures on benchmark tasks frequently fail or yield suboptimal performance due to a highly non-convex and irregular loss landscape. In these settings, optimization often stagnates in poor local minima and saddle points of the loss landscape, preventing the model from discovering the global minimum point. The internal mechanisms of these single-head looped transformer models remain poorly understood, and training them from scratch remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we propose a novel training framework that leverages Tsallis entropy and Hamiltonian dynamics to transform the geometry of the loss landscape. By treating the parameter updates as a physical flow, we successfully trained a single-head looped Transformer with model dimension $d = 8$ to solve induction head task with input sequence length of 1000 tokens. This success reveals the internal mechanism behind the superior reasoning capability.

AI.title_translation: 能量-熵正则化：最小循环Transformer的真正威力
AI.tldr: 循环Transformer很难训练，因为它们的损失函数地形很糟糕。我们引入了基于Tsallis熵和哈密顿动力学的“能量-熵正则化”方法，成功训练了一个小规模的单头循环Transformer解决了长序列推理任务，证明了这种正则化方法的有效性并揭示了其工作原理。
AI.motivation: 当前的单头循环Transformer训练方法在基准任务上经常失败或性能不佳，因为其损失地形高度非凸且不规则，优化容易陷入差的局部极小值和鞍点，导致模型无法发现全局最小值，且其内部机制缺乏理解。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的训练框架，利用Tsallis熵和哈密顿动力学来改变损失地形的几何结构，将参数更新视为物理流进行优化。
AI.result: 成功训练了一个模型维度$d=8$的单头循环Transformer，使其能够解决输入序列长度为1000个token的归纳头任务。
AI.conclusion: 成功训练了一个单头循环Transformer来解决长序列（1000个token）的归纳头任务，揭示了循环结构优越推理能力背后的内部机制。
AI.translation: 最近的研究表明，与标准深度架构相比，循环Transformer具有更优越的推理能力。在基准任务上训练单头循环架构的方法经常失败或产生次优性能，这是由于高度非凸且不规则的损失地形。在这些情况下，优化通常停滞在损失地形的差的局部极小值和鞍点中，阻碍了模型发现全局最小值点。这些单头循环Transformer模型的内部机制仍然知之甚少，从头开始训练它们仍然是一个重大挑战。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的训练框架，它利用Tsallis熵和哈密顿动力学来改变损失地形的几何结构。通过将参数更新视为物理流，我们成功地训练了一个模型维度$d=8$的单头循环Transformer，使其能够解决输入序列长度为1000个token的归纳头任务。这一成功揭示了其优越推理能力背后的内部机制。
AI.summary: 循环Transformer具有优越的推理能力，但其单头架构训练困难，因损失地形不规则。本文提出了一种名为“能量-熵正则化”的新颖训练框架，它利用Tsallis熵和哈密顿动力学来平滑损失地形的几何结构，成功地从头训练了一个单头循环Transformer来解决长序列归纳头任务，并揭示了其推理能力背后的机制。
AI.keywords: 循环Transformer, 能量-熵正则化, Tsallis熵, 哈密顿动力学, 损失地形
AI.comments: 这项工作的主要创新在于引入了基于Tsallis熵和哈密顿动力学的“能量-熵正则化”框架，有效地平滑了单头循环Transformer训练中遇到的高度非凸、不规则的损失地形，从而解决了训练不稳定和收敛到差局部极小值的问题。这不仅使训练成为可能，还揭示了循环结构优越推理能力背后的机制。限制在于，实验仅在$d=8$的单头模型上展示了成功，其泛化性有待进一步验证。

title: LLMs Got Rhythm? Hybrid Phonological Filtering for Greek Poetry Rhyme Detection and Generation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs), despite their remarkable capabilities across NLP tasks, struggle with phonologically-grounded phenomena like rhyme detection and generation. This is even more evident in lower-resource languages such as Modern Greek. In this paper, we present a hybrid system that combines LLMs with deterministic phonological algorithms to achieve accurate rhyme identification/analysis and generation. Our approach implements a comprehensive taxonomy of Greek rhyme types, including Pure, Rich, Imperfect, Mosaic, and Identical Pre-rhyme Vowel (IDV) patterns, and employs an agentic generation pipeline with phonological verification. We evaluate multiple prompting strategies (zero-shot, few-shot, Chain-of-Thought, and RAG-augmented) across several LLMs including Claude 3.7 and 4.5, GPT-4o, Gemini 2.0 and open-weight models like Llama 3.1 8B and 70B and Mistral Large. Results reveal a significant "Reasoning Gap": while native-like models (Claude 3.7) perform intuitively (40\% accuracy in identification), reasoning-heavy models (Claude 4.5) achieve state-of-the-art performance (54\%) only when prompted with Chain-of-Thought. Most critically, pure LLM generation fails catastrophically (under 4\% valid poems), while our hybrid verification loop restores performance to 73.1\%. We release our system and a corpus of 40,000+ rhymes, derived from the Anemoskala and Interwar Poetry corpora, to support future research.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型有节奏感吗？用于希腊诗歌押韵检测和生成的混合音韵过滤
AI.tldr: 大型语言模型在处理希腊语诗歌韵律时表现不佳。研究人员设计了一个混合系统，结合LLMs和硬编码的音韵规则，显著提高了韵律检测和生成的准确性，特别是将生成性能从接近零提升到73.1%。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在处理依赖于语音的现象（如韵律检测和生成）方面存在困难，尤其是在现代希腊语等低资源语言中更为明显。研究动机是开发一个能克服这些限制的系统。
AI.method: 提出一个结合大型语言模型（LLMs）和确定性音韵算法的混合系统。该系统实现了对希腊韵类型的全面分类（纯、丰富、不完美、马赛克和相同前韵元音（IDV）模式），并采用带有音韵验证的代理生成流程。评估了多种提示策略（零样本、少样本、思维链和RAG增强）和多种LLMs。
AI.result: 在识别任务中，原生模型（Claude 3.7）的准确率为40%，而推理密集型模型（Claude 4.5）在思维链提示下达到最先进的54%。纯LLM生成性能灾难性（低于4%的有效诗歌），而混合验证循环将性能恢复到73.1%。
AI.conclusion: 该混合系统通过结合LLMs和确定性音韵算法，成功实现了对现代希腊语诗歌韵脚的准确识别、分析和生成。与纯LLM方法相比，混合验证循环将生成性能从灾难性的低于4%提升至73.1%。研究还揭示了LLMs在音韵推理上的“推理鸿沟”，并发布了相关系统和语料库以支持未来研究。
AI.translation: 尽管大型语言模型在自然语言处理任务中具有卓越的能力，但在像押韵检测和生成这样的基于语音的现象上却表现不佳。这在现代希腊语等资源较少的语言中更为明显。在本文中，我们提出了一个结合大型语言模型和确定性音韵算法的混合系统，以实现准确的押韵识别/分析和生成。我们的方法实现了希腊押韵类型的全面分类，包括纯押、丰富押、不完美押、马赛克押和相同前韵元音（IDV）模式，并采用带有音韵验证的代理生成流程。我们评估了多种提示策略（零样本、少样本、思维链和RAG增强）在Claude 3.7和4.5、GPT-4o、Gemini 2.0以及Llama 3.1 8B和70B以及Mistral Large等开源模型上的表现。结果揭示了一个显著的“推理鸿沟”：虽然原生模型（Claude 3.7）表现直观（识别准确率为40%），但推理密集型模型（Claude 4.5）只有在采用思维链提示时才能达到最先进的性能（54%）。最关键的是，纯LLM生成性能灾难性（有效诗歌低于4%），而我们的混合验证循环将性能恢复到73.1%。我们发布了我们的系统和源自Anemoskala和Interwar Poetry语料库的40,000多个押韵的语料库，以支持未来的研究。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种混合系统，结合大型语言模型（LLMs）与确定性的音韵算法，以解决现代希腊语诗歌中韵律检测和生成所面临的挑战。该系统实现了对希腊韵类型的全面建模和代理生成流程。实验结果显示，LLMs存在“推理鸿沟”，且纯LLM生成失败，但通过引入音韵验证循环，生成性能从低于4%显著提升至73.1%。研究人员发布了该系统和相关语料库。
AI.keywords: LLMs, 希腊诗歌, 韵律检测, 混合系统, 音韵过滤
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于结合了大型语言模型（LLMs）的生成能力和确定性音韵算法的精确性，特别针对低资源语言（现代希腊语）的诗歌韵律问题，并揭示了LLMs在音韵推理上的“推理鸿沟”。混合系统在生成任务上取得了显著的性能提升，解决了纯LLM生成灾难性的问题。

title: The Spatial Blindspot of Vision-Language Models
comments: Work done as part of the EleutherAI SOAR Program
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have advanced rapidly, but their ability to capture spatial relationships remains a blindspot. Current VLMs are typically built with contrastive language-image pretraining (CLIP) style image encoders. The training recipe often flattens images into 1D patch sequences, discarding the 2D structure necessary for spatial reasoning. We argue that this lack of spatial awareness is a missing dimension in VLM design and a bottleneck for applications requiring spatial grounding, such as robotics and embodied AI. To address this, we investigate (i) image encoders trained with alternative objectives and (ii) 2D positional encodings. Our experiments show that these architectural choices can lead to improved spatial reasoning on several benchmarks.
comment: Work done as part of the EleutherAI SOAR Program

AI.title_translation: 视觉语言模型的空间盲点
AI.tldr: 当前的视觉语言模型在处理空间关系方面存在不足，主要是因为它们将图像展平成一维序列，丢失了二维结构。本文提出通过改进图像编码器和引入二维位置编码来解决这个问题，实验表明这些方法能提升空间推理能力。
AI.motivation: 当前的视觉语言模型（VLMs）在捕捉空间关系方面存在不足，这阻碍了它们在需要空间理解的应用（如机器人和具身AI）中的发展。
AI.method: 研究了（一）使用替代目标训练的图像编码器和（二）二维位置编码。
AI.result: 实验表明，这些架构选择可以提高在几个基准测试上的空间推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 缺乏空间意识是视觉语言模型设计中的一个缺失维度，也是限制其在需要空间理解的应用中表现的瓶颈。
AI.translation: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）发展迅速，但它们捕捉空间关系的能力仍然是一个盲点。目前的VLMs通常采用对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）风格的图像编码器构建。训练方法通常将图像展平成一维块序列，丢弃了空间推理所需的二维结构。我们认为，这种空间意识的缺乏是VLM设计中缺失的一个维度，也是机器人和具身AI等需要空间基础的应用的瓶颈。为了解决这个问题，我们研究了（i）使用替代目标训练的图像编码器和（ii）二维位置编码。我们的实验表明，这些架构选择可以在几个基准测试上提高空间推理能力。
AI.summary: 本文指出，当前的视觉语言模型（VLMs）在处理图像的空间关系方面存在显著不足，因为它们在训练过程中通常会将二维图像信息展平成一维序列，从而丢失了进行空间推理的关键二维结构信息。这种“空间盲点”限制了VLMs在机器人和具身AI等领域的应用。为了解决这一问题，研究者探索了两种方法：一是采用不同的训练目标来训练图像编码器，二是引入二维位置编码。实验结果表明，这些改进措施能够有效提升VLMs在空间推理任务上的表现。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型,空间关系,二维结构,图像编码器,位置编码
AI.comments: 该研究指出了当前视觉语言模型在处理空间信息方面的一个关键局限性，并提出了切实可行的改进方向。通过关注图像编码器的设计和位置信息的引入，为提升模型的空间推理能力提供了新的思路。实验结果的有效性需要进一步在更广泛的应用场景中进行验证。

title: Outrunning Big KATs: Efficient Decision Procedures for Variants of GKAT
summary: This paper presents several efficient decision procedures for trace equivalence of GKAT automata, which make use of on-the-fly symbolic techniques via SAT solvers. To demonstrate applicability of our algorithms, we designed symbolic derivatives for CF-GKAT, a practical system based on GKAT designed to validate control-flow transformations. We implemented the algorithms in Rust and evaluated them on both randomly generated benchmarks and real-world control-flow transformations. Indeed, we observed order-of-magnitude performance improvements against existing implementations for both KAT and CF-GKAT. Notably, our experiments also revealed a bug in Ghidra, an industry-standard decompiler, highlighting the practical viability of these systems.

AI.title_translation: 跑赢大KAT：GKAT变体的有效决策过程
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种利用SAT求解器进行符号处理的有效方法，用于GKAT自动机的跟踪等价性判定，并在实际应用中取得了显著的性能提升，同时还发现了Ghidra中的一个bug。
AI.motivation: 为了对GKAT自动机的跟踪等价性进行判定，需要开发更高效的决策过程。
AI.method: 利用SAT求解器进行对on-the-fly符号技术，并为CF-GKAT（一个基于GKAT的实际系统）设计了符号导数。
AI.result: 在随机生成的基准测试和实际的控制流转换上，与现有的KAT和CF-GKAT实现相比，观察到了数量级的性能提升。此外，还发现了Ghidra中的一个bug。
AI.conclusion: 提出的决策过程在效率上优于现有方法，并且在实际应用中具有可行性，甚至可以帮助发现工业标准工具中的错误。
AI.translation: 本文提出了几种用于GKAT自动机跟踪等价性的高效决策过程，它们利用了通过SAT求解器实现的即时符号技术。为了展示我们算法的适用性，我们为CF-GKAT设计了符号导数，CF-GKAT是基于GKAT的一个实际系统，旨在验证控制流转换。我们在Rust中实现了这些算法，并在随机生成的基准测试和实际的控制流转换上进行了评估。事实上，我们观察到与现有的KAT和CF-GKAT实现相比，性能有了数量级的提升。值得注意的是，我们的实验还揭示了Ghidra（一个行业标准的去编译器）中的一个bug，突显了这些系统的实际可行性。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种用于GKAT自动机跟踪等价性的高效决策过程，该过程利用SAT求解器进行即时符号处理。研究人员为CF-GKAT设计了符号导数，并在Rust中实现了该算法。实验结果表明，与现有方法相比，该方法在性能上有了数量级的提升，并成功发现了Ghidra中的一个bug。
AI.keywords: GKAT, 跟踪等价性, SAT求解器, 符号方法, CF-GKAT
AI.comments: 这项工作在GKAT自动机的跟踪等价性判定方面取得了显著进展，通过引入基于SAT求解器的符号技术，实现了显著的性能提升。算法在实际应用中的成功验证以及发现工业级工具（Ghidra）中的bug，都证明了其有效性和实用价值。未来的工作可以进一步探索该方法在更复杂系统和场景中的应用。

title: Rewriting Systems on Arbitrary Monoids
summary:
In this paper, we introduce monoidal rewriting systems (MRS), an abstraction of string rewriting in which reductions are defined over an arbitrary ambient monoid rather than a free monoid of words. This shift is partly motivated by logic: the class of free monoids is not first-order axiomatizable, so "working in the free setting" cannot be treated internally when applying first-order methods to rewriting presentations.
  To analyze these systems categorically, we define $\mathbf{NCRS_2}$ as the 2-category of Noetherian Confluent MRS. We then prove the existence of a canonical biadjunction between $\mathbf{NCRS_2}$ and $\mathbf{Mon}$.
  Finally, we classify all Noetherian Confluent MRS that present a given fixed monoid. For this, we introduce Generalized Elementary Tietze Transformations (GETTs) and prove that any two presentations of a monoid are connected by a (possibly infinite) sequence of these transformations, yielding a complete characterization of generating systems up to GETT-equivalence.

title: Translating database mathematical schemes into relational database software applications with MatBase
comments: Pre-print submitted to Journal of Advances in Knowledge-Based Systems, Data Science, and Cybersecurity, ISSN 2582-9793, on January 22, 2026
summary: We present a pseudocode algorithm for translating our (Elementary) Mathematical Data Model schemes into relational ones and associated sets of non-relational constraints, used by MatBase, our intelligent data and knowledge base management system prototype. We prove that this algorithm is very fast, solid, complete, and optimal. We apply it to a mathematical scheme modeling the genealogical trees subuniverse. We also provide examples of SQL and VBA code for enforcing some of its non-relational constraints, as well as guidelines to develop code for enforcing such constraints.

AI.title_translation: 将数据库数学模式翻译成关系数据库软件应用程序（通过MatBase）
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种将数学数据模型模式转换为关系模式的算法，并用于MatBase系统。该算法被证明是快速、可靠、完整和最优的，并应用于家谱树领域。论文还提供了执行非关系约束的SQL和VBA代码示例及指南。
AI.motivation: 将数学模式（如MatBase系统使用的）转换为关系模式，并处理非关系约束，以便在关系数据库软件应用中使用。
AI.method: 提出并证明了一个用于将数学数据模型模式转换为关系模式和非关系约束集的伪代码算法。该算法应用于家谱树模型，并提供了执行非关系约束的SQL和VBA代码示例。
AI.result: 开发了一个快速、可靠、完整且最优的算法，用于将数学模式转换为关系模式。成功应用于家谱树模型，并提供了执行非关系约束的代码示例和指南。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的算法能够有效地将数学数据模型模式转换为关系模式，并能处理相关的非关系约束，适用于MatBase等智能数据和知识库管理系统。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种用于将我们的（初等）数学数据模型模式转换为关系模式和相关非关系约束集的伪代码算法，这些约束集由我们的智能数据和知识库管理系统原型MatBase使用。我们证明了该算法非常快速、可靠、完整且最优。我们将其应用于模拟系谱树子宇宙的数学模式。我们还提供了用于强制执行其某些非关系约束的SQL和VBA代码示例，以及用于强制执行此类约束的代码开发指南。
AI.summary: 本研究介绍了一种将（初等）数学数据模型模式转换为关系模式及相关非关系约束集的伪代码算法，该算法已被MatBase系统采用。研究证明了该算法的高效性、稳健性、完整性和最优性，并以系谱树模型为例进行了应用。此外，研究还提供了强制执行非关系约束的SQL和VBA代码实例，以及相关的开发指南。
AI.keywords: 数学数据模型, 关系数据库, 非关系约束, 算法, MatBase
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种将数学数据模型转换为关系数据库模式的创新算法，解决了在关系数据库中处理非关系约束的挑战。算法的有效性和最优性得到了证明，并提供了实际的代码示例，具有重要的理论和实践意义。然而，论文可能需要进一步探讨该算法在处理更复杂数学模型和约束方面的扩展性。

title: Massively Multilingual Joint Segmentation and Glossing
comments: 13 pages, 8 figures, submitted to ARR Jan 2026
summary:
Automated interlinear gloss prediction with neural networks is a promising approach to accelerate language documentation efforts. However, while state-of-the-art models like GlossLM achieve high scores on glossing benchmarks, user studies with linguists have found critical barriers to the usefulness of such models in real-world scenarios. In particular, existing models typically generate morpheme-level glosses but assign them to whole words without predicting the actual morpheme boundaries, making the predictions less interpretable and thus untrustworthy to human annotators.
  We conduct the first study on neural models that jointly predict interlinear glosses and the corresponding morphological segmentation from raw text. We run experiments to determine the optimal way to train models that balance segmentation and glossing accuracy, as well as the alignment between the two tasks. We extend the training corpus of GlossLM and pretrain PolyGloss, a family of seq2seq multilingual models for joint segmentation and glossing that outperforms GlossLM on glossing and beats various open-source LLMs on segmentation, glossing, and alignment. In addition, we demonstrate that PolyGloss can be quickly adapted to a new dataset via low-rank adaptation.
comment: 13 pages, 8 figures, submitted to ARR Jan 2026

title: Where to Touch, How to Contact: Hierarchical RL-MPC Framework for Geometry-Aware Long-Horizon Dexterous Manipulation
summary: A key challenge in contact-rich dexterous manipulation is the need to jointly reason over geometry, kinematic constraints, and intricate, nonsmooth contact dynamics. End-to-end visuomotor policies bypass this structure, but often require large amounts of data, transfer poorly from simulation to reality, and generalize weakly across tasks/embodiments. We address those limitations by leveraging a simple insight: dexterous manipulation is inherently hierarchical - at a high level, a robot decides where to touch (geometry) and move the object (kinematics); at a low level it determines how to realize that plan through contact dynamics. Building on this insight, we propose a hierarchical RL--MPC framework in which a high-level reinforcement learning (RL) policy predicts a contact intention, a novel object-centric interface that specifies (i) an object-surface contact location and (ii) a post-contact object-level subgoal pose. Conditioned on this contact intention, a low-level contact-implicit model predictive control (MPC) optimizes local contact modes and replans with contact dynamics to generate robot actions that robustly drive the object toward each subgoal. We evaluate the framework on non-prehensile tasks, including geometry-generalized pushing and object 3D reorientation. It achieves near-100% success with substantially reduced data (10x less than end-to-end baselines), highly robust performance, and zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

title: Combating Spurious Correlations in Graph Interpretability via Self-Reflection
summary:
Interpretable graph learning has recently emerged as a popular research topic in machine learning. The goal is to identify the important nodes and edges of an input graph that are crucial for performing a specific graph reasoning task. A number of studies have been conducted in this area, and various benchmark datasets have been proposed to facilitate evaluation. Among them, one of the most challenging is the Spurious-Motif benchmark, introduced at ICLR 2022. The datasets in this synthetic benchmark are deliberately designed to include spurious correlations, making it particularly difficult for models to distinguish truly relevant structures from misleading patterns. As a result, existing methods exhibit significantly worse performance on this benchmark compared to others.
  In this paper, we focus on improving interpretability on the challenging Spurious-Motif datasets. We demonstrate that the self-reflection technique, commonly used in large language models to tackle complex tasks, can also be effectively adapted to enhance interpretability in datasets with strong spurious correlations. Specifically, we propose a self-reflection framework that can be integrated with existing interpretable graph learning methods. When such a method produces importance scores for each node and edge, our framework feeds these predictions back into the original method to perform a second round of evaluation. This iterative process mirrors how large language models employ self-reflective prompting to reassess their previous outputs. We further analyze the reasons behind this improvement from the perspective of graph representation learning, which motivates us to propose a fine-tuning training method based on this feedback mechanism.

title: Self-Augmented Mixture-of-Experts for QoS Prediction
summary:
Quality of Service (QoS) prediction is one of the most fundamental problems in service computing and personalized recommendation. In the problem, there is a set of users and services, each associated with a set of descriptive features. Interactions between users and services produce feedback values, typically represented as numerical QoS metrics such as response time or availability. Given the observed feedback for a subset of user-service pairs, the goal is to predict the QoS values for the remaining pairs.
  A key challenge in QoS prediction is the inherent sparsity of user-service interactions, as only a small subset of feedback values is typically observed. To address this, we propose a self-augmented strategy that leverages a model's own predictions for iterative refinement. In particular, we partially mask the predicted values and feed them back into the model to predict again. Building on this idea, we design a self-augmented mixture-of-experts model, where multiple expert networks iteratively and collaboratively estimate QoS values. We find that the iterative augmentation process naturally aligns with the MoE architecture by enabling inter-expert communication: in the second round, each expert receives the first-round predictions and refines its output accordingly. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that our method outperforms existing baselines and achieves competitive results.

title: Extractive summarization on a CMOS Ising machine
summary: Extractive summarization (ES) aims to generate a concise summary by selecting a subset of sentences from a document while maximizing relevance and minimizing redundancy. Although modern ES systems achieve high accuracy using powerful neural models, their deployment typically relies on CPU or GPU infrastructures that are energy-intensive and poorly suited for real-time inference in resource-constrained environments. In this work, we explore the feasibility of implementing McDonald-style extractive summarization on a low-power CMOS coupled oscillator-based Ising machine (COBI) that supports integer-valued, all-to-all spin couplings. We first propose a hardware-aware Ising formulation that reduces the scale imbalance between local fields and coupling terms, thereby improving robustness to coefficient quantization: this method can be applied to any problem formulation that requires k of n variables to be chosen. We then develop a complete ES pipeline including (i) stochastic rounding and iterative refinement to compensate for precision loss, and (ii) a decomposition strategy that partitions a large ES problem into smaller Ising subproblems that can be efficiently solved on COBI and later combined. Experimental results on the CNN/DailyMail dataset show that our pipeline can produce high-quality summaries using only integer-coupled Ising hardware with limited precision. COBI achieves 3-4.5x runtime speedups compared to a brute-force method, which is comparable to software Tabu search, and two to three orders of magnitude reductions in energy, while maintaining competitive summary quality. These results highlight the potential of deploying CMOS Ising solvers for real-time, low-energy text summarization on edge devices.

title: Enhancing Model Context Protocol (MCP) with Context-Aware Server Collaboration
summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) (MCP Community, 2025) has emerged as a widely used framework for enabling LLM-based agents to communicate with external tools and services. The original MCP implementation (Anthropic, 2024) relies on a Large Language Model (LLM) to decompose tasks and issue instructions to servers. In particular, the agents, models, and servers are stateless and do not have access to a global context. However, in tasks involving LLM-driven coordination, it is natural that a Shared Context Store (SCS) could improve the efficiency and coherence of multi-agent workflows by reducing redundancy and enabling knowledge transfer between servers. Thus, in this work, we design and assess the performance of a Context-Aware MCP (CA-MCP) that offloads execution logic to specialized MCP servers that read from and write to a shared context memory, allowing them to coordinate more autonomously in real time. In this design, context management serves as the central mechanism that maintains continuity across task executions by tracking intermediate states and shared variables, thereby enabling persistent collaboration among agents without repeated prompting. We present experiments showing that the CA-MCP can outperform the traditional MCP by reducing the number of LLM calls required for complex tasks and decreasing the frequency of response failures when task conditions are not satisfied. In particular, we conducted experiments on the TravelPlanner (Yang et al., 2024) and REALM-Bench (Geng & Chang, 2025) benchmark datasets and observed statistically significant results indicating the potential advantages of incorporating a shared context store via CA-MCP in LLM-driven multi-agent systems.

title: Bayesian ICA for Causal Discovery
summary: Causal discovery based on Independent Component Analysis (ICA) has achieved remarkable success through the LiNGAM framework, which exploits non-Gaussianity and independence of noise variables to identify causal order. However, classical LiNGAM methods rely on the strong assumption that there exists an ordering under which the noise terms are exactly independent, an assumption that is often violated in the presence of confounding. In this paper, we propose a general information-theoretic framework for causal order estimation that remains applicable under arbitrary confounding. Rather than imposing independence as a hard constraint, we quantify the degree of confounding by the multivariate mutual information among the noise variables. This quantity is decomposed into a sum of mutual information terms along a causal order and is estimated using Bayesian marginal likelihoods. The resulting criterion can be interpreted as Bayesian ICA for causal discovery, where causal order selection is formulated as a model selection problem over permutations. Under standard regularity conditions, we show that the proposed Bayesian mutual information estimator is consistent, with redundancy of order $O(\log n)$. To avoid non-identifiability caused by Gaussian noise, we employ non-Gaussian predictive models, including multivariate $t$ distributions, whose marginal likelihoods can be evaluated via MCMC. The proposed method recovers classical LiNGAM and DirectLiNGAM as limiting cases in the absence of confounding, while providing a principled ranking of causal orders when confounding is present. This establishes a unified, confounding-aware, and information-theoretically grounded extension of ICA-based causal discovery.

title: Language-Guided and Motion-Aware Gait Representation for Generalizable Recognition
summary: Gait recognition is emerging as a promising technology and an innovative field within computer vision, with a wide range of applications in remote human identification. However, existing methods typically rely on complex architectures to directly extract features from images and apply pooling operations to obtain sequence-level representations. Such designs often lead to overfitting on static noise (e.g., clothing), while failing to effectively capture dynamic motion regions, such as the arms and legs. This bottleneck is particularly challenging in the presence of intra-class variation, where gait features of the same individual under different environmental conditions are significantly distant in the feature space. To address the above challenges, we present a Languageguided and Motion-aware gait recognition framework, named LMGait. To the best of our knowledge, LMGait is the first method to introduce natural language descriptions as explicit semantic priors into the gait recognition task. In particular, we utilize designed gait-related language cues to capture key motion features in gait sequences. To improve cross-modal alignment, we propose the Motion Awareness Module (MAM), which refines the language features by adaptively adjusting various levels of semantic information to ensure better alignment with the visual representations. Furthermore, we introduce the Motion Temporal Capture Module (MTCM) to enhance the discriminative capability of gait features and improve the model's motion tracking ability. We conducted extensive experiments across multiple datasets, and the results demonstrate the significant advantages of our proposed network. Specifically, our model achieved accuracies of 88.5%, 97.1%, and 97.5% on the CCPG, SUSTech1K, and CASIAB datasets, respectively, achieving state-of-the-art performance. Homepage: https://dingwu1021.github.io/LMGait/

title: R$^2$PO: Decoupling Training Trajectories from Inference Responses for LLM Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning has become a central paradigm for improving LLM reasoning. However, existing methods use a single policy to produce both inference responses and training optimization trajectories. The objective conflict between generating stable inference responses and diverse training trajectories leads to insufficient exploration, which harms reasoning capability. In this paper, to address the problem, we propose R$^2$PO (Residual Rollout Policy Optimization), which introduces a lightweight Residual Rollout-Head atop the policy to decouple training trajectories from inference responses, enabling controlled trajectory diversification during training while keeping inference generation stable. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that our method consistently outperforms baselines, achieving average accuracy gains of 3.4% on MATH-500 and 1.3% on APPS, while also reducing formatting errors and mitigating length bias for stable optimization. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/RRPO-ARR/Code.

title: From LLMs to Agents in Programming: The Impact of Providing an LLM with a Compiler
summary: Large Language Models have demonstrated a remarkable capability in natural language and program generation and software development. However, the source code generated by the LLMs does not always meet quality requirements and may fail to compile. Therefore, many studies evolve into agents that can reason about the problem before generating the source code for the solution. The goal of this paper is to study the degree to which such agents benefit from access to software development tools, in our case, a gcc compiler. We conduct a computational experiment on the RosettaCode dataset, on 699 programming tasks in C. We evaluate how the integration with a compiler shifts the role of the language model from a passive generator to an active agent capable of iteratively developing runnable programs based on feedback from the compiler. We evaluated 16 language models with sizes ranging from small (135 million) to medium (3 billion) and large (70 billion). Our results show that access to a compiler improved the compilation success by 5.3 to 79.4 percentage units in compilation without affecting the semantics of the generated program. Syntax errors dropped by 75%, and errors related to undefined references dropped by 87% for the tasks where the agents outperformed the baselines. We also observed that in some cases, smaller models with a compiler outperform larger models with a compiler. We conclude that it is essential for LLMs to have access to software engineering tools to enhance their performance and reduce the need for large models in software engineering, such as reducing our energy footprint.

title: Understanding Partial Reachability in the Internet Core
summary: Routing strives to connect all the Internet, but compete: political pressure threatens routing fragmentation; architectural changes such as private clouds, carrier-grade NAT, and firewalls make connectivity conditional; and commercial disputes create partial reachability for days or years. This paper suggests *persistent, partial reachability is fundamental to the Internet* and an underexplored problem. We first *derive a conceptual definition of the Internet core* based on connectivity, not authority. We identify *peninsulas*: persistent, partial connectivity; and *islands*: when computers are partitioned from the Internet core. Second, we develop algorithms to observe each across the Internet, and apply them to two existing measurement systems: Trinocular, where 6 locations observe 5M networks frequently, and RIPE Atlas, where 13k locations scan the DNS roots frequently. Cross-validation shows our findings are stable over *three years of data*, and consistent with as few as 3 geographically-distributed observers. We validate peninsulas and islands against CAIDA Ark, showing good recall (0.94) and bounding precision between 0.42 and 0.82. Finally, our work has broad practical impact: we show that *peninsulas are more common than Internet outages*. Factoring out peninsulas and islands as noise can *improve existing measurement systems*; their ``noise'' is $5\times$ to $9.7\times$ larger than the operational events in RIPE's DNSmon. We show that most peninsula events are routing transients (45\%), but most peninsula-time (90\%) is due to a few (7\%) long-lived events. Our work helps inform Internet policy and governance, with our neutral definition showing no single country or organization can unilaterally control the Internet core.

title: XR$^3$: An Extended Reality Platform for Social-Physical Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Social-physical human-robot interaction (spHRI) is difficult to study: building and programming robots that integrate multiple interaction modalities is costly and slow, while VR-based prototypes often lack physical contact, breaking users' visuo-tactile expectations. We present XR$^3$, a co-located dual-VR-headset platform for HRI research in which an attendee and a hidden operator share the same physical space while experiencing different virtual embodiments. The attendee sees an expressive virtual robot that interacts face-to-face in a shared virtual environment. In real time, the robot's upper-body motion, head and gaze behavior, and facial expressions are mapped from the operator's tracked limbs and face signals. Because the operator is co-present and calibrated in the same coordinate frame, the operator can also touch the attendee, enabling perceived robot touch synchronized with the robot's visible hands. Finger and hand motion is mapped to the robot avatar using inverse kinematics to support precise contact. Beyond motion retargeting, XR$^3$ supports social retargeting of multiple nonverbal cues that can be experimentally varied while keeping physical interaction constant. We detail the system design and calibration, and demonstrate the platform in a touch-based Wizard-of-Oz study, lowering the barrier to prototyping and evaluating embodied, contact-based robot behaviors.

title: HyFormer: Revisiting the Roles of Sequence Modeling and Feature Interaction in CTR Prediction
summary: Industrial large-scale recommendation models (LRMs) face the challenge of jointly modeling long-range user behavior sequences and heterogeneous non-sequential features under strict efficiency constraints. However, most existing architectures employ a decoupled pipeline: long sequences are first compressed with a query-token based sequence compressor like LONGER, followed by fusion with dense features through token-mixing modules like RankMixer, which thereby limits both the representation capacity and the interaction flexibility. This paper presents HyFormer, a unified hybrid transformer architecture that tightly integrates long-sequence modeling and feature interaction into a single backbone. From the perspective of sequence modeling, we revisit and redesign query tokens in LRMs, and frame the LRM modeling task as an alternating optimization process that integrates two core components: Query Decoding which expands non-sequential features into Global Tokens and performs long sequence decoding over layer-wise key-value representations of long behavioral sequences; and Query Boosting which enhances cross-query and cross-sequence heterogeneous interactions via efficient token mixing. The two complementary mechanisms are performed iteratively to refine semantic representations across layers. Extensive experiments on billion-scale industrial datasets demonstrate that HyFormer consistently outperforms strong LONGER and RankMixer baselines under comparable parameter and FLOPs budgets, while exhibiting superior scaling behavior with increasing parameters and FLOPs. Large-scale online A/B tests in high-traffic production systems further validate its effectiveness, showing significant gains over deployed state-of-the-art models. These results highlight the practicality and scalability of HyFormer as a unified modeling framework for industrial LRMs.

title: A Two-Stage GPU Kernel Tuner Combining Semantic Refactoring and Search-Based Optimization
summary: GPU code optimization is a key performance bottleneck for HPC workloads as well as large-model training and inference. Although compiler optimizations and hand-written kernels can partially alleviate this issue, achieving near-hardware-limit performance still relies heavily on manual code refactoring and parameter tuning. Recent progress in LLM-agent-based kernel generation and optimization has been reported, yet many approaches primarily focus on direct code rewriting, where parameter choices are often implicit and hard to control, or require human intervention, leading to unstable performance gains. This paper introduces a template-based rewriting layer on top of an agent-driven iterative loop: kernels are semantically refactored into explicitly parameterizable templates, and template parameters are then optimized via search-based autotuning, yielding more stable and higher-quality speedups. Experiments on a set of real-world kernels demonstrate speedups exceeding 3x in the best case. We extract representative CUDA kernels from SGLang as evaluation targets; the proposed agentic tuner iteratively performs templating, testing, analysis, and planning, and leverages profiling feedback to execute constrained parameter search under hardware resource limits. Compared to agent-only direct rewriting, the template-plus-search design significantly reduces the randomness of iterative optimization, making the process more interpretable and enabling a more systematic approach toward high-performance configurations. The proposed method can be further extended to OpenCL, HIP, and other backends to deliver automated performance optimization for real production workloads.

title: An Evolutionary Framework for Automatic Optimization Benchmark Generation via Large Language Models
summary: Optimization benchmarks play a fundamental role in assessing algorithm performance; however, existing artificial benchmarks often fail to capture the diversity and irregularity of real-world problem structures, while benchmarks derived from real-world problems are costly and difficult to construct. To address these challenges, we propose an evolutionary automatic benchmark generation framework that leverages a large language model (LLM) as a generative operator, termed the LLM-driven evolutionary benchmark generator (LLM-EBG). In this framework, the LLM serves as an evolutionary operator that generates and evolves benchmark problems within a flexible, expressive representation space. As a case study, we generate unconstrained single-objective continuous minimization problems represented as mathematical expressions designed to induce significant performance differences between a genetic algorithm (GA) and differential evolution (DE). Experimental results show that LLM-EBG successfully produces benchmark problems in which the designated target algorithm consistently outperforms the comparative algorithm in more than 80\% of trials. Furthermore, exploratory landscape analysis reveals that benchmarks favoring GA are highly sensitive to variable scaling, demonstrating that the proposed framework can generate problems with distinct geometric characteristics that reflect the intrinsic search behaviors of different optimization algorithms.

title: Who Does This Name Remind You of ? Nationality Prediction via Large Language Model Associative Memory
summary: Large language models (LLMs) possess extensive world knowledge, yet methods for effectively eliciting this knowledge remain underexplored. Nationality and region prediction tasks require understanding of not only linguistic features but also cultural and historical background, making LLM world knowledge particularly valuable. However, conventional LLM prompting methods rely on direct reasoning approaches, which have limitations in applying abstract linguistic rules. We propose LLM Associative Memory Agents (LAMA), a novel framework that leverages LLM world knowledge as associative memory. Rather than directly inferring nationality from names, LAMA recalls famous individuals with the same name and aggregates their nationalities through indirect reasoning. A dual-agent architecture comprising a Person Agent and a Media Agent, specialized in different knowledge domains, recalls famous individuals in parallel, generating Top-1 predictions through voting and Top-K predictions through conditional completion. On a 99-country nationality prediction task, LAMA achieved 0.817 accuracy, substantially outperforming conventional LLM prompting methods and neural models. Our experiments reveal that LLMs exhibit higher reliability in recalling concrete examples than in abstract reasoning, that recall-based approaches are robust to low-frequency nationalities independent of data frequency distributions, and that the dual-agent architecture functions complementarily to produce synergistic effects. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of a new multi-agent system that retrieves and aggregates LLM knowledge rather than prompting reasoning.

title: Mining Citywide Dengue Spread Patterns in Singapore Through Hotspot Dynamics from Open Web Data
comments: 9 pages, 9 figures. It's accepted by WWW 2026 Web4Good Track. To make accessible earlier, authors would like to put it on arxiv before the conference
summary: Dengue, a mosquito-borne disease, continues to pose a persistent public health challenge in urban areas, particularly in tropical regions such as Singapore. Effective and affordable control requires anticipating where transmission risks are likely to emerge so that interventions can be deployed proactively rather than reactively. This study introduces a novel framework that uncovers and exploits latent transmission links between urban regions, mined directly from publicly available dengue case data. Instead of treating cases as isolated reports, we model how hotspot formation in one area is influenced by epidemic dynamics in neighboring regions. While mosquito movement is highly localized, long-distance transmission is often driven by human mobility, and in our case study, the learned network aligns closely with commuting flows, providing an interpretable explanation for citywide spread. These hidden links are optimized through gradient descent and used not only to forecast hotspot status but also to verify the consistency of spreading patterns, by examining the stability of the inferred network across consecutive weeks. Case studies on Singapore during 2013-2018 and 2020 show that four weeks of hotspot history are sufficient to achieve an average F-score of 0.79. Importantly, the learned transmission links align with commuting flows, highlighting the interpretable interplay between hidden epidemic spread and human mobility. By shifting from simply reporting dengue cases to mining and validating hidden spreading dynamics, this work transforms open web-based case data into a predictive and explanatory resource. The proposed framework advances epidemic modeling while providing a scalable, low-cost tool for public health planning, early intervention, and urban resilience.

title: Static Detection of Core Structures in Tigress Virtualization-Based Obfuscation Using an LLVM Pass
comments: 7 pages, 7figures, An extended version of this work has been submitted to the Journal of KIISC
summary: Malware often uses obfuscation to hinder security analysis. Among these techniques, virtualization-based obfuscation is particularly strong because it protects programs by translating original instructions into attacker-defined virtual machine (VM) bytecode, producing long and complex code that is difficult to analyze and deobfuscate. This paper aims to identify the structural components of virtualization-based obfuscation through static analysis. By examining the execution model of obfuscated code, we define and detect the key elements required for deobfuscation-namely the dispatch routine, handler blocks, and the VM region-using LLVM IR. Experimental results show that, in the absence of compiler optimizations, the proposed LLVM Pass successfully detects all core structures across major virtualization options, including switch, direct, and indirect modes.
